title: Yu-Gi-Oh! On RPG Maker XP , what do i need?

posts.author: YuseiBestFudo
posts.body: So guys i recently got XP and i am thinking about starting my project, well i dont know any programation language or am professional or that, i am thinking about making a Yu-Gi-Oh Based game, if possible even make a Duel System if not maybe a regular Battle System with Yu-gi-oh rules and Cards, could make me happy, what do i need? How do i even start?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
with a scrap project of any theme to start learning the engine.
that project will never be completed and will only be there for you to experiment with everything until you have the basics and can start another project for a real game.
read the help file and tutorials here on the forum and try to make the same parts for yourself in the scrap project.
